scope: Reconcile a new downstream DWG/DXF dimension text-position report with the DXF contract, the local authoritative ODA DWG specification, and the local implementation/test coverage.

method.kind: Primary format-specification review plus local source/test audit
sourcesOpened: tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp: dimensionFrameMatches and ARC_DIMENSION flag controls
method.evidenceBoundary: The ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.22 mapping is byte-layout authority. CADCraft issue behavior is an open downstream report with no attached drawing; local code was inspected but not executed in this research pass.

evidence.observed: CADCraft issue #1094 reports that its generated DXF used group 70 value 32 and its generated DWG appeared as 128 in AutoCAD 2026; after moving a dimension definition point, the DXF text recentered while the DWG text stayed fixed. The report provides generated commands and black-box observations but no drawing artifact. A contributor says the required bridge mapping inverts DWG Flags 1 bit 0 relative to DXF bit 128 and maps bit 1 to DXF bit 32; this proposed fix is not release-qualified.
doesNotEstablish: reproduction of the reported files or AutoCAD behavior in this task
a released or independently validated CADCraft fix
evidence.planUse: Use the issue as a regression-test lead only. Keep CADCraft, OpenCADStudio, and ACadRust within their existing shared codec-lineage bucket.

evidence.observed: Autodesk's common DXF DIMENSION codes define bit 128 as user-positioned text and bit 32 as a dimension-only picture-block reference flag. Local ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.22, pp. 125-126, says DWG common-dimension Flags 1 bit 0 is the opposite of DXF bit 128 and bit 1 matches DXF bit 32.
doesNotEstablish: application-level text regeneration behavior after editing a dimension
that every producer sets optional/legacy bits identically beyond the documented contract
evidence.planUse: Assert the wire mapping directly: DWG bit 0 clear corresponds to DXF bit 128 set; DWG bit 1 corresponds to DXF bit 32. Preserve subtype, mandatory version policy, and midpoint fields independently.

evidence.observed: Local DWG parsing maps Flags 1 bit 0 inversely to type bit 0x80 and bit 1 to type bit 0x20; the writer reverses that mapping. The DXF writer preserves higher flags while deriving subtype from the concrete class and forces bit 32 for post-R12 output. Existing generated dimension-frame tests cover type/geometry/frames but omit assertions for bits 32/128 and DWG Flags 1; ARC_DIMENSION subclass flags are a separate field.
doesNotEstablish: native CAD acceptance or complete dimension editing semantics
evidence.planUse: Add raw-wire-first vectors to the existing dimension test owner, then parse and assert the same fields. No new CTest, external sample, or dependency is needed.

nextActions: Add literal ASCII and Binary DXF cases with bit 32 on and bit 128 off/on; inspect emitted tags before parseback.
Add a locally generated DWG vector and compare Flags 1 against ODA before reader round-trip.
Use the existing focused dimension test target; defer optional AutoCAD edit/regeneration to a composed native checkpoint.
Keep all six external-J items DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
